title: descurainia pinnata subsp. glabra
intro: Descurainia pinnata subsp. glabra, commonly known as White Buttercup, is a flowering plant native to Asia and Europe. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, treating fever, and alleviating digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of White Buttercup are attributed to its ability to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of White Buttercup include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
